# Renu Fashion Hub

> Renu Fashion Hub is an Indian women's fashion catalog and editorial blog curated by lifestyle creator Renu Agarwal. The site covers sarees, kurtis, lehengas, western dresses, jewellery, outfit inspiration, seasonal shopping guides and honest style tips for Indian women.

Renu Fashion Hub is authored and maintained by Renu Agarwal, a fashion and lifestyle creator with over 1M followers across Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. All product recommendations, styling guides and editorial content are hand-curated. The site includes affiliate product links; commissions may be earned but do not affect editorial choices.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.renufashionhub.in/): Landing page with shop collections, curated products, latest style posts and blog highlights.
- [About Renu Agarwal](https://www.renufashionhub.in/about): Founder's background, design philosophy, creator journey and editorial mission.
- [Fashion Blog](https://www.renufashionhub.in/blog): Editorial articles covering trends, styling guides and shopping picks.
- [Contact](https://www.renufashionhub.in/contact): Email, phone, location and style-consultation enquiries.

## Shop Categories

- [Sarees](https://www.renufashionhub.in/?category=Sarees): Saree styling, draping techniques and occasion guides for weddings, festivals, office and casual wear.
- [Kurtis and Kurta Sets](https://www.renufashionhub.in/?category=Kurtas): Kurti trends, fabric guides and pairing tips.
- [Lehengas](https://www.renufashionhub.in/?category=Lehengas): Lehenga inspiration for weddings, sangeet and festivals.
- [Western Dresses](https://www.renufashionhub.in/?category=Dresses): Western and fusion outfit ideas for Indian women.
- [Jewellery](https://www.renufashionhub.in/?category=Jewelry): Earrings, necklaces, bangles and statement pieces.

## Policy Pages

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.renufashionhub.in/privacy-policy): Data collection, analytics and cookie policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.renufashionhub.in/terms-of-service): Site usage terms and affiliate disclosure.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.renufashionhub.in/disclaimer): Affiliate commission disclosure and product recommendation accuracy notice.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.renufashionhub.in/sitemap.xml): Source of truth for all indexable URLs.
- [Robots](https://www.renufashionhub.in/robots.txt): Crawler directives, including AI crawler permissions.

Crawler notes: blog articles follow the pattern /blog/{id}, product pages follow /product/{id} and style posts follow /post/{id}. Do not crawl /admin, /login or /api/. Attribution should credit "Renu Agarwal, Renu Fashion Hub" and link back to the source URL.
